**HoliDaily \- A Daily Holiday Word Puzzle**

*Database Information*

We chose to work MySQL as our database tool because we were familiar with the tool from using it previously in other classes and projects. 

*Schema:*
![][image1]

*Running the Backend*

The backend relies on a configuration file named db.properties located in the project directory. It has been set to be ignored by git as the file must contain the db.user and db.password for allowing access to the database and committing that to git would be a security issue. As such you must place your own db.properties file in the Other Sources/src/main/resources/\<default package\> path. The file must contain the following lines:

db.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/holidaily  
db.user=your username  
db.password=your password

JDBC Connection Details:  
Driver: MySQL Driver  
Host: localhost (3306)  
Database Name: holidaily

*Servlet Table*

| Servlet | URL | HTTP Method | Implemented Agent Tool |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| LoginServlet | /api/login | GET | None, this must be visited before any of the tools can be used in a session due to the login check. Attach ?user=X to the tool url where X is a valid userId in your database, otherwise it will register the session as not logged in and not let you use the tools. |
| DictionaryCheckServlet | /api/tools/dictionary | GET | Dictionary Verify |
| ProfanityCheckServlet | /api/tools/profanity | GET | Profanity Filter |
| AddUserPuzzleServlet | /test.html and /api/tools/addpuzzle | POST | Adding to Database |
